sentences.en: As you make your bed, you must lie on it.
sentences.zh: 1. 你铺好了床，就得躺在上面。

sentences.en: The doctor demanded I stay in bed for a week.
sentences.zh: 2. 医生要求我卧床休息一周。

sentences.en: It's time to go to bed. Turn off the radio.
sentences.zh: 3. 到睡觉时间了。把收音机关掉吧。
